harvest_meta.input: post-Nesterov lerp(grad, momentum, beta) passed to the orthogonalizer

promotion_gate.criterion: register only if step-20 held-out error improves sharply over the registered circuit of the same split while mid/late median <= PS3_55 and Fable R1/R2/R3 + CUDA-graph bitwise replay pass

SS3_54E0.reason: step-20 median improves only 13% (0.233 -> 0.202) and stays 2.5x above PS3_55 (0.082); it keeps mid/late below PS3_55 but gives up about half (53%) of SS3_54's mid/late lead, and its design error (0.118) and sigma_max (1.119) are worse. A tradeoff, not a sharp improvement.

promotion_gate.why: under-lift at x ~ 1e-3 persists across the 20 tested polish starts and enforced safety bounds: SS3_54E0 (5+4) lifts slope_at_zero only from 584.3 to 650.0 (reducing step-20 held-out median from 0.2326 to 0.2024 vs PS3_55 0.0822) while surrendering 52.9% (mid) and 53.0% (late) of SS3_54's lead; among the tested starts, one 5+3 start passed scalar safety without qualifying for validation, and all tested 3+4 and 3+5 starts failed the safety band
